motive.zhHans: 据透露，整起绑架案都是假的，原因是 Manami 要去大分寻找她的前男友。事实证明他是一名同谋，但他并没有绑架 Manami，而是为了分赃款。在他的推断中，还有一名同谋，那就是 Yozo Hozogai，第二名同谋，他的任务是拿到赃款，而真正的犯人将分得一半。Ehara 把钱藏在游客小屋里，并把钱换成了书。证据是他手上有痕迹，那是江户川柯南画的荧光笔印记，这样犯人只要碰过就会留下证据。如果他和 Manami 结婚，他就能拿到所有的钱。之前的抢劫是 Ehara 策划的，但门被锁上了，所以他没拿到赃款。Ryuji Ogikubo 45岁 强盗 Nakadai Electric 前员工 未遂抢劫 地点：东京某条不明小巷 受害者：一名 Nakadai Electric 运钞员 犯人：Ryuji Ogikubo 三周前，一名携带1亿日元的 Nakadai Electric 运钞员遭到一名戴太阳镜的持械强盗残酷拦截，后来查明该强盗就是 Ryuji Ogikubo。然而，当 Nakadai 的车被逼停时，撞上了小巷的墙壁，使其后舱门的框架变形，导致犯人在警察赶到之前无法抢走钱。
motive.en: It is revealed that the whole kidnapping was fake, it is because Manami was going to Oita in order to find her ex-boyfriend. It turns that he was an accomplice, but he didn't kidnapped Manami, but in order to split the stolen money. In his deduction, there was one more accomplice, and it was Yozo Hozogai, the second accomplice, his order was to get the stolen money, and the real culprit would have the half of it. Ehara hid the money in the visitor's cabin and changed the money into books. The evidence is there are marks on his hand which is the highlighter that Conan draw, so that the culprit would have touched it and leave evidence. If he marry Manami, he could have all the money. The robbery before was staged by Ehara, but the door was locked so he didn't got the stolen money. Ryuji Ogikubo 45 years old Robber Nakadai Electric's former employee Attempted Robbery Location: Unknown alley in Tokyo Victim: A Nakadai Electric money transporter Culprit: Ryuji Ogikubo Three weeks prior, a Nakadai Electric money transporter with 100 million yen was brutally stopped by an armed robber wearing sunglasses, later revealed to be Ryuji Ogikubo. However, when the Nakadai car was forced into a stop, it impacted an alley wall, warping the frame of its backhatch, which rendered the culprit unable to snatch the money before the police arrived.
